hints.title: Build combinations by denomination
hints.body: Process one denomination at a time. Once a denomination is fixed, only combinations that use it may be extended with it.

hints.title: One-dimensional ways
hints.body: Let `ways[x]` be the number of combinations that make total `x` using the denominations processed so far. Initialize `ways[0] = 1` for the empty combination.

hints.title: Outer loop over coins
hints.body: For each coin, walk totals upward from the coin value and add `ways[total - coin]`. The upward walk allows unlimited copies of that coin, while processing coins in the outer loop prevents the same multiset from being counted in different orders.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
ways = zeros of length amount + 1
ways[0] = 1
for coin in coins:
    for total from coin to amount:
        ways[total] += ways[total - coin]
return ways[amount]
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
